examName: Assistant Professor (Geography) Maharashtra Education Service, Group-A & Lecturer (Geography) Maharashtra Education Service, Group-B (Collegiate Branch), Higher and Technical Education Department - Syllabus
examNameMr: सहाय्यक प्राध्यापक (भूगोल) महाराष्ट्र शिक्षण सेवा, गट-अ आणि व्याख्याता (भूगोल) महाराष्ट्र शिक्षण सेवा, गट-ब (महाविद्यालयीन शाखा), उच्च आणि तंत्र शिक्षण विभाग - अभ्यासक्रम
examPattern: Written Examination / Screening Test followed by Document Verification or Interview

topics: Interior of the earth, Continental Drift, Plate Tectonics, Endogenetic and Exogenetic forces
Denudation and Weathering, Geomorphic Cycle (Davis and Penck), Theories and Process of Slope Development
Earth Movements (seismicity, folding, faulting and vulcanicity), Land form
Occurrence and Causes of Geomorphic Hazards (earthquakes, volcanoes, landslides and avalanches)
Applied Geomorphology (Hydrology, Urbanization, Hazard management and Regional planning)
Composition and Structure of Atmosphere
Insolation, Heat Budget of Earth, Temperature, Pressure and Winds
Atmospheric Circulation (air-masses, fronts and upper air circulation, cyclones and anticyclones) (tropical and temperate)
Types of Precipitation, Climatic Classification of Koppen & Thornthwaite
ENSO Events (El Nino, La Nina and Southern Oscillations)
Meteorological Hazards and Disasters (Cyclones, Thunderstorms, Tornadoes, Hailstorms, Heat and Cold waves, Drought and Cloudburst, Glacial Lake Outburst (GLOF))
Climate Change: Evidences and Causes of Climatic Change in the past, Urban climate, Human impact on Global Climate
Relief of Oceans, Composition: Temperature, Density and Salinity
Circulation: Warm and Cold Currents, Waves, Tides, Sea Level Changes
Ocean Deposits, Coral reefs and coral bleaching
Hazards: Tsunami and Cyclone, Laws of Marine pollution
Components: Ecosystem (Geographic Classification) and Human Ecology
Functions: Trophic Levels, Energy Flows, Cycles (geo-chemical, carbon, nitrogen and oxygen), Food Chain, Food Web and Ecological Pyramid
Human Interaction and Impacts, Environmental Ethics and Deep Ecology
Environmental Hazards and Disasters (Global Warming, Urban Heat Island, Atmospheric Pollution, Water Pollution, Land Degradation)
Environmental Policies, International Treaties, International Programmes and Policies (Brundtland Commission, Kyoto Protocol, Agenda 21, Sustainable Development Goals, Paris Agreement)
Sources of population data (census, sample surveys and vital statistics, data reliability and errors)
World Population Distribution (measures, patterns and determinants), World Population Growth (prehistoric to modern period)
Concept of Over, Under and Optimum population, Demographic Transition, Theories of Population Growth (Malthus, Sadler, and Ricardo)
Fertility and Mortality Analysis (indices, determinants, and world patterns)
Migration (types, causes and consequences and models), Population Composition and Characteristics (age, sex, rural-urban, occupational structure, and educational levels)
Population Policies in Developed and Developing Countries

Rural Settlements (types, patterns and distribution), Contemporary Problems of Rural Settlements with special reference to India (rural-urban migration, land use changes, land acquisition and transactions)
Theories of Origin of Towns (Gordon Childe, Henri Pirenne, Lewis Mumford)
Characteristics and Processes of Urbanization in Developed and Developing Countries
Urban Systems (the law of the primate city and rank size rule), Central Place Theories (Christaller and Losch)
Internal Structure of the City, Models of Urban Land Use (Burgess, Harris and Ullman and Hoyt)
Concepts of Megacities, Global Cities and Edge Cities, Changing Urban Forms, Functional classification of Towns
Social Segregation in the City, Urban Social Area Analysis, Manifestation of Poverty in the City (slums, informal sector growth, crime and social exclusion)

units.unitTitle: Geography of Economic Activities and Regional Development
units.unitTitleMr: आर्थिक क्रियांचे भूगोल आणि प्रादेशिक विकास
topics: Factors affecting spatial organisation of economic activities (primary, secondary, tertiary and quaternary)
Natural Resources (classification, distribution and associated problems), Natural Resources Management
World Energy Crises in Developed and Developing Countries, Water crisis with special reference to India
Agricultural Geography: Land capability classification and Land Use Planning, Cropping Pattern, Crop diversification, Von Thunen's Model
Agricultural Productivity, Agro-Forestry, Agricultural Systems of the World
Industrial Geography: Classification of Industries, Factors and Theories of Industrial Location (A. Weber, E. M. Hoover, August Losch, A. Pred, D. M. Smith)
World Industrial Regions, Impact of Globalisation, Tourism Industry, ICT and Knowledge Production Industries
Geography of Transport and Trade: Theories and Models of spatial interaction, Spatial Flow Models, World Trade Organisation, Globalisation and Liberalisation, Ports and Regional Cooperation

Regional Development: Typology of Regions, World Regional Disparities, Theories of Regional Development (Hirschman, Myrdal, Friedman, Dependency theory), Regional Development and Social Movements in India
Concept of Culture, Cultural Complexes, Areas and Region, Cultural Heritage, Cultural Ecology, Cultural Convergence
Social Structure and Processes, Social Well-being and Quality of Life, Social Exclusion
Spatial distribution of social groups in India (Tribe, Caste, Religion and Language), Major Tribes and their problems
Environment and Human Health, Diseases Ecology, Nutritional Status, Health Care Planning and Policies in India, Medical Tourism
Political Geography: Boundaries, Frontiers and Related issues, Heartland and Rimland Theories
Geography of Federalism, Electoral Reforms in India, Determinants of Electoral Behaviour
Geopolitics of Climate Change, World Resources, and Indian Ocean, Regional Organisations (SAARC, ASEAN, OPEC, EU)
Contributions of Greek, Roman, Arab, Chinese and Indian Scholars
Contributions of Geographers (Bernhardus Varenius, Immanuel Kant, Alexander von Humboldt, Carl Ritter, Schaefer & Hartshorne)
Impact of Darwinian Theory on Geographical Thought, Contemporary trends in Indian Geography
Major Geographic Traditions, Dualisms in Geographic Studies, Paradigm Shift
Perspectives in Geography (Positivism, Behaviouralism, Humanism, Structuralism, Feminism and Postmodernism)
Sources of Geographic Information and Data, Types of Maps, Techniques of Map Making, Data Representation on Maps
GIS Database (raster and vector data formats and attribute data formats), Functions of GIS, Digital Elevation Model (DEM), Georeferencing, GIS Applications
Basics of Remote Sensing, Sensors and Platforms, Resolution, Aerial Photographs, Digital Image Processing, GPS Components and Applications
Applications of Measures of Central Tendency, Dispersion and Inequalities, Sampling and Hypothesis Testing (chi square, t-test, ANOVA)
Time Series Analysis, Correlation and Regression Analysis, Measurement of Indices, Principal Component Analysis and Cluster Analysis
Morphometric Analysis: Ordering of Streams, Bifurcation Ratio, Drainage Density, Basin Circularity Ratio, Profiles, Slope Analysis
Major Physiographic Regions, Drainage System (Himalayan and Peninsular), Climate, Indian Monsoon, Jet Streams and Himalayan Cryosphere
Types and Distribution of Natural Resources (Soil, Vegetation, Water, Mineral and Marine)
Population Characteristics, Growth, Composition, Determinants and Population Policies in India
Agriculture: Production, Productivity, Crop Regions, Agro-Climatic Zones, Green Revolution, Livestock resources, Food Security and Public Distribution System
Industrial Development since Independence, Industrial Regions and Policies
Development and Patterns of Transport Networks, Internal and External Trade, Growing Importance of ports
Regional Development Planning in India, Globalisation and its impact on Indian Economy
Natural Disasters in India (Earthquake, Drought, Flood, Cyclone, Tsunami, Himalayan High land Hazards)
